description: Job Records: submit one payment proof or settled-payment record (amount, service or endpoint, transaction reference, timestamp) with your account of the lost or missing result and any service response records you hold. The signed report ties each response to the payment by its reference or by endpoint and time, says whether the records show the result delivered, not delivered or unresolved, and names the safe next step they support: re_request_same_reference, present_proof_to_seller or treat_as_unresolved. The report never pays again and the seller is never contacted. Verdict delivered, not_delivered or unresolved. POST /api/payment-recovery-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, wallet or merchant lookup, order, payment or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/job-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/job-records/.
